concept: CloudWatch alarm on a metric + SNS notification
tests: How to get notified with minimal effort when CPU stays above a threshold for a set time.
expected: CloudWatch alarm on CPUUtilization (80% threshold, period/evaluation periods covering 10 minutes) with an SNS notification action. Triggers: "notified automatically", "CPU above 80% for 10 minutes", "LEAST overhead".
why_not: A polling Lambda reinvents what CloudWatch already does; manually checking the console isn't automation; CloudTrail data events — API activity, not metrics.
